company.name: GradeWiz
company.shortDescription: GradeWiz is an AI tool that helps teachers create rubrics, grade assignments, and provide feedback.
company.description: GradeWiz provides tools to grade student tests, homework, and exams using computer vision and AI. The platform segments student work, matches it to students, and applies grading rubrics automatically. It supports rubric creation, learning from instructor instructions, and analyzing common mistakes. The system generates feedback for each student and tracks performance data to guide teaching. The platform includes documentation, support, and account management tools for instructors and institutions.
